title: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Recognition with Vision-Language Models: Challenges on Granularity and Specificity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance discrepancies between coarse-grained class prompts and predictions aggregated from finer-grained children classes using a semantic hierarchy adapted from ImageNet and WordNet.

Using an image-to-text retrieval task on the MS-COCO dataset to evaluate how models respond to textual inputs of varying specificity (e.g., single/multi-label prompts, overly detailed localized narratives) and subtly modified incorrect captions.
